Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe

Class ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery
public final class ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery extends Object
Recovers common pressure and temperature from fixed phase masses, momenta, energy and cell volume.

Each supplied homogeneous EOS state represents the actual transported composition of one phase. Recovery varies only pressure and temperature; it never flashes or redistributes components between phases. All energy quantities are per unit pipe length, and the caloric reference may therefore give negative internal energy.

  • Method Details

    • recover

      public static ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery.Result recover(TwoFluidSection section, SystemInterface[] phaseStates)
      Recover a conservative endpoint within the numerical temperature interval 50 to 2000 K.
      Parameters:
      section - candidate conservative cell, unchanged by this method
      phaseStates - gas/oil/aqueous homogeneous EOS templates; null is allowed only for an absent phase
      Returns:
      recovered thermodynamic state
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs are inadmissible
      IllegalStateException - if no admissible converged recovery is found

    • recover

      public static ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery.Result recover(TwoFluidSection section, SystemInterface[] phaseStates, double minimumTemperatureK, double maximumTemperatureK)
      Recover pressure and temperature without modifying a cell, its inventories, or the supplied EOS states.
      Parameters:
      section - candidate conservative cell
      phaseStates - gas/oil/aqueous homogeneous EOS templates at fixed phase compositions
      minimumTemperatureK - lower admissible temperature in K
      maximumTemperatureK - upper admissible temperature in K
      Returns:
      converged thermodynamic endpoint
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs are inadmissible
      IllegalStateException - if the EOS or nonlinear recovery fails

    • evaluate

      private static ConservativeThermodynamicRecovery.Evaluation evaluate(SystemInterface[] fluids, double[] state, double logPressure, double logTemperature)
      Evaluate occupied area and internal energy at fixed phase composition.
      Parameters:
      fluids - private homogeneous EOS states
      state - fixed conservative variables per unit length
      logPressure - logarithm of absolute pressure in Pa
      logTemperature - logarithm of temperature in K
      Returns:
      thermodynamic residual quantities
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if EOS properties are invalid
